theme: log field extract BETWEEN FINDI structured peel

tests.name: positive_extract
tests.note: hit=4 miss=2; rows Error|box|disk full etc.

tests.name: quiet_strict
tests.note: exit 0 with CLEAR_ERR after FINDI misses

weaknesses.title: BETWEEN peels first open→first close only — nested delimiters corrupt fields
weaknesses.detail: SYS BETWEEN "[" "]" on '[outer [inner]] msg="x"' yields severity 'outer [inner'. No balanced/nested extract. Real log formats with nested brackets need shell/regex.

weaknesses.title: OK=0 without last_err does not fail run -s
weaknesses.detail: FINDI/FIND miss sets OK=0 LAST_N=-1 but empty last_err. STATUS shows ok=false momentarily, yet final plate under -s can still be ok=true if no sticky ERR. Agents cannot rely on OK alone for strict gates — inconsistent with AGE miss which sets last_err=mtime: missing.
weaknesses.repro: SYS FINDI hello xyz under -q -s → exit 0 ok=true; STATUS mid-run ok=false last_err empty

weaknesses.title: BETWEEN miss is soft OK=1 LAST_N=0 — easy to confuse with EMPTY success
weaknesses.detail: Unlike FINDI, BETWEEN miss keeps OK=1. Must check LAST_N/found. Dual soft-miss conventions across host forms (READ_OK vs LAST_N vs OK).

weaknesses.title: No multi-match / global extract — one BETWEEN per call
weaknesses.detail: Cannot pull all bracket tags or all quoted strings from a line without manual loop+replace glue. No BETWEEN ALL form.
weaknesses.repro: Line with two quoted strings only peels first

weaknesses.title: TRIM still missing from forms/search
weaknesses.detail: Carry-over; field peels often need strip.

workarounds: Use simple [sev] at line start; avoid nested brackets in severity tags
After FINDI miss always CLEAR_ERR if continuing under -s; do not assume OK trips strict
Branch on BETWEEN LAST_N not OK
Chain REPLACE to remove first match then BETWEEN again for multi-field
LET bag = LAST after every PUSH
language_gaps: Unify soft-miss: either sticky last_err for all OK=0 or document OK-only probes
Strict mode option: fail on OK=0
